package com.acme.loyalty.model;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Immutable ledger entry. Positive points = earn, negative = burn.
 * JSON shape: {"memberId": 1, "points": -200, "reason": "REDEEM; voucher"}
 */
public record PointsTransaction(
        Long memberId,
        int points,
        String reason,
        Instant occurredAt) {

    /** Compact canonical constructor; every reference component is mandatory. */
    public PointsTransaction {
        Objects.requireNonNull(memberId, "memberId");
        Objects.requireNonNull(reason, "reason");
        Objects.requireNonNull(occurredAt, "occurredAt");
    }

    public static PointsTransaction earn(final Long memberId, final int points, final String reason) {
        return new PointsTransaction(memberId, Math.abs(points), reason, Instant.now());
    }

    public PointsTransaction reversed() {
        return new PointsTransaction(memberId, -points, "REVERSAL: " + reason, occurredAt);
    }

    // Accessors are spelled out because the API checker requires Javadoc on every public method.

    /** Owning member's database id. */
    @Override
    public Long memberId() {
        return memberId;
    }

    /** Signed points: positive = earn, negative = burn. */
    @Override
    public int points() {
        return points;
    }

    /** Free-text reason, e.g. "REDEEM; voucher #12". */
    @Override
    public String reason() {
        return reason;
    }

    /** When the transaction happened (UTC). */
    @Override
    public Instant occurredAt() {
        return occurredAt;
    }
}
